verdict.rationale: Segments exist in HubSpot, but only as UI-configured email recipients or 'View in segments' actions. The cited API is the Marketing Emails API, which does not create segments, and the MCP server probe gives no detail on segment creation. Nothing shows an agent turning a plain-language audience description into a real segment through a programmatic surface; the campaign agent and the MCP server are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
